title: SAS H2O MICHEL — claimed by thegentlemen
description: FR · Other · h2o-michel.fr huissiers-bordeaux.com SAS H2O MICHEL is a French commissaire de justice firm (public judicial officer — serving court documents, enforcing judgments, debt recovery) created in 2018 and based in Tours/Chinon, Val de Loire (Indre-et-Loire). It is led by President Alexandra Michel and operates 5 offices (Tours, Chinon, Bourgueil, Langeais, Château-la-Vallière) with a small team of 3–7
